requester.chat: Soporte Worker - Actualizacion de tickets de venta

objective: Tickets de venta — Bloque 1: auditar esquemas reales SR/MPRO y EDARSAHUB, rutas de sincronizacion dia/abiertas/cerradas, atomicidad de partidas, cliente/RFC/direccion, comentarios y tipos de descuento, cancelaciones; identificar diferencias entre detalle Comercial con Asistente IA y Ejecutivo. Solo lectura. Resultado necesario antes de construir migraciones, sincronizadores y componentes compartidos.

queries.name: esquema_ticket_destino_y_campos_relacionados
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (TABLE_NAME IN ('Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2','Sync_Sales','Sync_Clientes') OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%cliente%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%comentario%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%direccion%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%tipodescuento%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%rfc%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: vistas_ticket_cliente_descuento
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS esquema,o.name AS objeto,o.type_desc,m.definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.type='V' AND (o.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR o.name LIKE '%VentasDetalle%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ventas_Dia%') ORDER BY o.name

queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,NUMERIC_PRECISION,NUMERIC_SCALE,IS_NULLABLE,ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(TABLE_NAME) IN ('tipodescuento','cheques','clientes','tempcheques') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION
